title: Artisan's Touch
intro: Artisan's Touch is an A-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Tactical Items. Use it to repair an equipment that is currently equipped.

title: Atomic Lighter

fields.quote: "A powerful lighter, its heat never wanes. Its flames ignite from the ashes of destruction, gather the dust, and fire is born anew. A continuous cycle."

intro: Atomic Lighter is an A-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Tactical Items. Throw it to cause a powerful explosion.

title: Atomic Snail

fields.quote: A little snail about to curl into itself. Rumors tell of a town once upon a time that had become madly obsessed with whirlpools. One would be pulled into the dreamy blue when looking at them for a long time. The continuous flow of color into the hole creates an illusion of "infinity.

intro: Atomic Snail is an A-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Whim Potions. Using the potion will grant the air dash ability.

title: Behemoth

fields.quote: Behemoth never stops charging forward. Neither does the rider on his back.; -"Unstoppable!"
fields.name: Behemoth

intro: Behemoth is an A-grade Combat Deviation that does P.ATK DMG. He is a loyal companion for George. He was added to the game on July 9, 2026 with the Version 3.0.1. Update<ref>https://www.oncehuman.game/news/update/20260709/40780_1307147.html</ref>

title: Blackback

fields.name: Blackback
fields.quote: A loyal companion for Metas.
fields.variants: None

intro: Blackback is an B-grade Territory Deviation that was added on April 24, 2025 with the Version 1.5.1. Update.<ref name=":0">https://www.oncehuman.game/news/update/20250421/40780_1229033.html</ref> It follows the player character in their territory and assists with sanity restoration.

title: Brave George

fields.quote: Brave George never lets go of his sword and shield. Just like his former master; --'Charge with me!'
fields.variants: None

intro: Note 1: Players can swap worlds/realms (servers) multiple times at the nearest Worldstone and re-check locations for even more spawns!

title: Butterfly's Emissary

fields.quote: A tiny paper butterfly, glowing with a rosy hue. The butterfly will guide you when you're lost, comfort you when you're in tears, and protect you when you're in danger. The one who folded the butterfly can't be with you just now, but this butterfly can be with you in her place. *Cherish the buttery [sic], for it will reciprocate in kind*
fields.variants: [File:Butterfly's Emissary - Glistening Blue.png|64px|link=Butterfly's Emissary#Butterfly's Emissary - Glistening Blue|Glistening Blue][File:Butterfly's Emissary - Starry Night.png|64px|link=Butterfly's Emissary#Butterfly's Emissary - Starry Night|Starry Night]

intro: Note 1: Players can swap worlds/realms (servers) multiple times at the nearest Worldstone and re-check locations for even more spawns!

title: Buzzy Bee

fields.quote: A toy car shaped like a bumblebee. It's like a little burst of spring has buzzed into the room. You can almost smell the flowers. A-a-achooo!
fields.name: Buzzy Bee
fields.variants: [File:Buzzy Bee - Infrasonic Illusion.png|64px|Infrasonic Illusion][File:Buzzy Bee - Pumpkin Lantern.png|64px|Pumpkin Lantern][File:Buzzy Bee - Radiant Flourish.png|64px|Radiant Flourish]

intro: Buzzy Bee is a B-grade Territory Deviation. When placed inside of a Securement Pod in the player character's territory, it will increase the rate at which player-planted crops become mutated.

title: By-The-Wind

fields.quote: A tiny lifeform too pure to be of this Earth. Unblessed children, dissonant chords of the celestial voices, evidence of a shattered whole. You can almost hear them singing, calling their progeny home. They spread their blossoms and open their arms in wait, for time stands with them. But perhaps you can offer them another choice?
fields.variants: [File:By-The-Wind - Bursting Magma.png|64px|link=By-The-Wind#By-The-Wind - Bursting Magma|Bursting Magma]

intro: By-The-Wind is an A-grade Combat Deviation that can generate walls of wind that block incoming bullets.

title: Cattiva

fields.name: Cattiva
fields.variants: None

intro: Cattiva is an S-grade Territory Deviation that was added on October 30, 2025 with the Version 2.2.0. Update.<ref>https://www.oncehuman.game/news/update/20251029/40780_1267745.html</ref> It works in the territory to gather ores or works at the Mining Platform.

title: Chefosaurus Rex

fields.quote: Who doesn't love this little green toy dinosaur? He's caring, he's clean, and he's an excellent chef! You never know what it'll pull out of its pocket next.
fields.variants: [File:Azure Melody - Chefosaurus Rex.png|64px|Azure Melody] [File:Chefosaurus Rex - Christmas Spirit.png|64px|Christmas Spirit]
fields.name: Chefosaurus Rex

intro: Note 1: Players can swap worlds/realms (servers) multiple times at the nearest Worldstone and re-check locations for even more spawns!

title: Chillet

fields.name: Chillet
fields.variants: None

intro: Chillet is an S-grade Territory Deviation that was added on October 30, 2025 with the Version 2.2.0. Update.<ref>https://www.oncehuman.game/news/update/20251029/40780_1267745.html</ref> It works in the territory to gather ores or works at the Mining Platform.

title: Chillet Ignis

fields.name: Chillet Ignis
fields.variants: None

intro: Chillet Ignis is an S-grade Territory Deviation that was added on October 30, 2025 with the Version 2.2.0. Update.<ref>https://www.oncehuman.game/news/update/20251029/40780_1267745.html</ref> It works in the territory to gather ores or works at the Mining Platform.

title: Director Fox
intro: Director Fox is an A-grade Territory Deviation that was added on October 29, 2025 with the Version 2.2.0. Update.<ref>https://www.oncehuman.game/news/official/20251022/40779_1266368.html</ref>

title: Disco Ball

fields.quote: A colorful disco ball, spinning on its own and radiating intense light. It uplifts the spirit, sending those touched by its light into a frenzy of excitement and euphoria. The ball reminisces about its last wild party, singing its own rock song. Waiting for its fans to return. But the dance hall is no more.

intro: Disco Ball is a B-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Whim Potions. Use it to extend other Whim duration.

title: Doberman

fields.name: Doberman
fields.quote: A loyal companion for Metas.
fields.variants: None

intro: Doberman is an B-grade Territory Deviation that was added on April 24, 2025 with the Version 1.5.1. Update.<ref name=":0">https://www.oncehuman.game/news/update/20250421/40780_1229033.html</ref> It follows the player character in their territory and assists with sanity restoration.

title: Doctor Raven

fields.quote: Doctor Raven is obsessed with studying novelties, and you're his favorite test subject. Claims to have mastered 999 flavors of Medicine.; -"Which one would you like today?"
fields.name: Doctor Raven

intro: Doctor Raven is an A-grade Territory Deviation that works in the territory to improve Supplies Workbench efficiency. Crafted Healing Syringes have a bonus effect.

title: Dr. Teddy

fields.quote: A devoted doctor with his trusty medkit. Forever rushing from one emergency to the next. So busy, he's forgotten his own name, voice, and face. But he'll never forget the oath he took.
fields.variants: [File:Dr. Teddy - Aberrant Progeny.png|64px|link=Dr. Teddy#Dr. Teddy - Aberrant Progeny|Aberrant Progeny] [File:Dr. Teddy - Guardian Block.png|64px|link=Dr. Teddy#Dr. Teddy - Guardian Block|Guardian Block]

intro: Dr. Teddy is an A-grade Combat Deviation that can heal allied deviations and heal or rescue fallen Metas.

title: Dreamcatcher

fields.quote: A delicate Dreamcatcher, woven from spider ilk, quivers from invisible footsteps. The silk, fragile like an illusion, vanishes in the blink of an eye, making it a harbinger of dreams. Children weave webs in unseen places, in corners, shadows, and your peripheral vision. Meanwhile, a famished mother awaits in the dream, full of anticipation.

intro: Dreamcatcher is a B-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Whim Potions. Unleashes a spiderweb trap to bind enemies when you are in danger.

title: Electric Eel

fields.quote: A string of large batteries wriggle like a lively eel. When threatened, they emit a powerful electric current. The dangerous world unites them as a group. The more members the greater the energy they can release.
fields.variants: [File:Electric Eel - Gold Lightning.png|64px|Gold Lightning]

intro: Electric Eel is a B-grade Territory Deviation that improves the Power of generators.

title: Enchanting Void
intro: Note 1: Players can swap worlds/realms (servers) multiple times at the nearest Worldstone and re-check locations for even more spawns!

title: Extradimensional Cat

fields.quote: A giant kitty sneaking into your garden. Napping in the sun and rolling about on the lawn. Every hair smells of the sun, like a fluffy cloud.
fields.variants: [File:Extradimensional Cat - Good Fortune.png|64px|link=Extradimensional Cat#Extradimensional Cat - Heavy Ginger|Good Fortune][File:Extradimensional Cat - Heavy Ginger.png|64px|link=Extradimensional Cat#Extradimensional Cat - Heavy Ginger|Heavy Ginger][File:Extradimensional Cat - Moonlit Jewels.png|64px|link=Extradimensional Cat#Extradimensional Cat - Moonlit Jewels|Moonlit Jewels] [File:Chaos Extradimensional Cat.png|64px|link=Extradimensional Cat#Chaos Extradimensional Cat|Chaos]

intro: Extradimensional Cat is an S-grade Territory Deviation that enjoys itself inside the Territory. Accompanies its owner to sleep to make sure that they're fully energetic the next day.

title: Festering Gel

fields.quote: A bright yellow semi-gold gel that expands slowly in the air. It greedily assimilates everything it touches. It starts off the size of a fist, but will quickly grow if left unchecked. It hunts by luring its prey to consume it... Doesn't it look delicious?
fields.variants: [File:Festering Gel - Marine Star.png|64px|link=Festering Gel#Festering Gel - Marine Star|Marine Star][File:Festering Gel - Spring Rose.png|64px|link=Festering Gel#Festering Gel - Spring Rose|Spring Rose]

intro: Festering Gel is a B-grade Combat Deviation that can participate in combat to transform into Shelter and block enemy attacks.

title: Fetch-A-Lot Bunny

fields.quote: An adventurous bunny rabbit that just loves to wander around the wastes. Forever curious about this strange world. Always popping off, then running off. Would you like to stay for tea?
fields.variants: [File:Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Alice.png|64px|link=Fetch-A-Lot Bunny#Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Alice|Alice][File:Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Aquarius.png|64px|link=Fetch-A-Lot Bunny#Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Aquarius|Aquarius][File:Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Dark Rebel.png|64px|link=Fetch-A-Lot Bunny#Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Dark Rebel|Dark Rebel][File:Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Gluttonous.png|64px|link=Fetch-A-Lot Bunny#Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Gluttonous|Gluttonous][File:Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Infrasonic Illusion.png|64px|link=Fetch-A-Lot Bunny#Fetch-A-Lot Bunny - Infrasonic Illusion|Infrasonic Illusion]

intro: Fetch-A-Lot Bunny is a B-grade Territory Deviation that works in the Territory to gather all sorts of Plants.

title: Flame Essence

fields.quote: An ancient creature with eyes half-open, half-shut. The hometown is already beyond reach, so what's the harm in adapting to wherever one is?
fields.variants: [File:Flame Essence - Golden Toad.png|64px|Golden Toad] [File:Flame Essence - Infrasonic Illusion.png|64px|Infrasonic Illusion] [File:Flame Essence - Prince.png|64px|Prince]

intro: Flame Essence is a B-grade Territory Deviation that increases the production efficiency of the Furnace and Electric Furnace. When activated, furnaces enjoy duration reduction of approximately 25-30%. One Flame Essence can only boost the efficiency of one furnace at a time. For an Electric Furnace the efficiency boost applies to both active formulas.

title: Frog the Leaper

fields.quote: A tin frog that can wind itself up. Once fully wound, it hops just like a real frog, higher with each bounce. And the higher it jumps, the more damage it causes. Try not to let it lose around the fine china.

intro: Unlocks the Spring Legs whim potion formula. Generates Silver Spring, a required material for crafting Spring Legs whim potions and Crankbait, a fishing bait for the fishing rod.

title: Gazocchio (Deviation)

fields.quote: An ever-burning lamp that guards its dim glow. When the night snuffs out all stars, there will always be a light left for those in need. Don't go gentle into that good night. Even if it's just a fleeting spark.
fields.name: Gazocchio

intro: Gazocchio (Deviation) is an S-grade Territory Deviation that will defend the player character's territory from invading enemies.

title: Gingerbread House

fields.quote: Cozy, yet tasty. The sweet scent of gingerbread fills the air as you lay your eyes upon it. A little slice of a life long gone. Why not take a bite, and imagine you live in better times? But be careful. You don't want to upset the lady of the house.

intro: Gingerbread House is an A-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft special Dishes. Consume it to transform into an object.

title: Growshroom

fields.quote: A silent Mushroom that gives its spores to the harsh world. Memory shattered, civilization silenced. Only the soil responds resolutely.
fields.variants: [File:Growshroom - Extra Large.png|64px|link=Growshroom#Growshroom - Extra Large|Extra Large][File:Growshroom - Green Touch.png|64px|link=Growshroom#Growshroom - Green Touch|Green Touch][File:Growshroom - Aberrant Progeny.png|64px|link=Growshroom#Growshroom - Aberrant Progeny|Aberrant Progeny]

intro: Growshroom is an A-grade Territory Deviation that works inside the Territory. Can proactively plant and harvest.

title: Grumpy Bulb

fields.quote: A putrid plant that emits a foul stench. Protected by an odor potent enough to drive a person to madness, they thrive in the Stardust-ridden soil. If nothing wants to get too close... Does that mean standing close to one of these plants is a pretty safe place to be?"

intro: Grumpy Bulb is an A-grade Combat Deviation that can participate in combat to disrupt enemy threat, making them attack each other. Deals AoE Status DMG and disrupts aggro.

title: H37 (Deviation)

fields.quote: A little round robot, with the most adorable ears. What is it planning? What is it thinking? Is it a good luck charm? Or an omen of despair?
fields.name: H37

intro: H37 (Deviation) is an A-grade Territory Deviation that enters strongholds occupied by the enemy and collects resources from their Storage Crates.

title: Harveseed

fields.quote: A pulsing red seed, the earth gently stirs with it. We'll be inspired, grow strong, and thrive with out friends. Brave ones become stronger, patient ones more resilient, delicate ones more beautiful. We won't stop renovating this world. The seed is red, the roots are black, the blossoms are white. Everything else will turn to green.

intro: Unlocks the Living Armor whim potion formula. Generates Heart Vines, a required material for crafting the Living Armor whim potion.

title: Hug-in-a-Bowl

fields.quote: Just a regular old bowl... Or is it? A pinch of frustration, a dash of love. That's life, you suppose. You take a deep breath and are reminded, inexplicably, of home.
fields.variants: [File:Hug-in-a-Bowl - Infrasonic Illusion.png|64px|Infrasonic Illusion]

intro: Hug-in-a-Bowl is a B-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft special Dishes. Consume to fully recover Sanity.

title: Hydrangeas

fields.variants: [File:Black Hydrangea.png|64px|Black Hydrangea] [File:Blue Hydrangea.png|64px|Blue Hydrangea] [File:Pink Hydrangea.png|64px|Pink Hydrangea] [File:Red Hydrangea.png|64px|Red Hydrangea] [File:Yellow Hydrangea.png|64px|Yellow Hydrangea] [File:Deviated Hydrangea.png|64px|Deviated Hydrangea]
fields.name: Hydrangeas
fields.quote: A bouquet of hydrangeas

intro: Hydrangeas can only be obtained from being player grown, either from planting Yellow or Blue Hydrangea Seeds, which can be found randomly when harvesting plants in the wilderness, by exploring locations around the wilderness and opening Storage Crates. The color of hydrangea seed planted determines the possible color of hydrangea the player will grow:

title: Hydronaut Fish

fields.quote: A solitary fish, leaving its school to walk onshore. Wisdom is both a blessing and a curse. The world it knew can no longer tolerate fools, but does the sea still have a place in its dreams?
fields.name: Hydronaut Fih

intro: Hydronaut Fish is an A-grade Territory Deviation that can work in the territory to gather Sea Water, or operate a water purification facility to get fish occasionally.

title: Ice Pot

fields.quote: A flawless crystal, carved into an eternal vessel. Inside, it holds glaciers enough to fill the entire world. What's outside reflects what's within, perfectly balanced. Whatever you do, do not turn it upside down.

intro: Ice Pot is a B-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Tactical Items. Use to make large ice cubes.

title: Invincible Sun

fields.quote: A caged sun, radiating endless light and heat. From the moment fire was first gazed upon, life has longed to tame it. We struck flint, ignited coal, reshaped steel, forged wings, and sent our wishes to the skies. One day, the stars themselves will rest in our hands.
fields.name: Invincible Sun
fields.variants: [File:Invincible Sun - Starfall Inversion.png|64px|link=Invincible Sun - Starfall Inversion|Starfall Inversion]

intro: Invincible Sun is an A-grade Combat Deviation that can participate in combat to periodically release blazing energy rays, which attack all nearby enemies, inflicting continuous Burn DMG.

title: Labrador

fields.name: Labrador
fields.quote: A loyal companion for Metas.
fields.variants: None

intro: Labrador is an B-grade Territory Deviation that was added on April 24, 2025 with the Version 1.5.1. Update.<ref name=":0">https://www.oncehuman.game/news/update/20250421/40780_1229033.html</ref> It follows the player character in their territory and assists with sanity restoration.

title: Lethal Rabbit

fields.quote: An ice-cold assassin, deadly in its precision. No delay, no hesitation. You will never see a trace of it at work, nor see any mess on its clothes. The secret of the blade is to always be one step ahead.

intro: Lethal Rabbit is an A-grade Territory Deviation that works inside the Territory. Can hunt animals and bring back Leather and Meat.

title: Logging Beaver

fields.quote: A diligent worker, he's even got his own hard hat. He'll complete every job on time, and within budget. Just don't try and make him do overtime. You got it?
fields.variants: [File:Logging Beaver - Christmas Spirit.png|64px|Christmas Spirit]

intro: Logging Beaver is an A-grade Territory Deviation that works within the Territory to gather Wood or work at the Logging Platform.

title: Lonewolf's Whisper

fields.quote: A pale canine carcass, hunger seeping from its marrow. An endless craving, an insatiable thirst. He who feeds the wolf will inevitably succumb, and join the pack himself. They grow, they feast, and they drive themselves to extinction in a fit of ravenous rage. With nothing left to devour, they can only gnaw upon their own skeletal remains.
fields.variants: [File:Lonewolf's Whisper - Bursting Magma.png|64px|link=Lonewolf's Whisper#Lonewolf's Whisper - Bursting Magma|Bursting Magma]

intro: Lonewolf's Whisper is an A-grade Combat Deviation that can participate in combat. Will transform into a black wolf and attack enemies.

title: Masonic Pyramid

fields.quote: A black stone pyramid shifting from improbable shape to improbable shape. An invitation, a key, a strange door. Touch it, and unlock the narrow confines of the self. A symbol of human courage from the not-so-distant past.

intro: Masonic Pyramid is a B-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Whim Potions. Use it to become invisible or spot hiding enemies.

title: Mini Feaster

fields.variants: [File:Mini Feaster - Starfall Inversion.png|64px|link=Mini Feaster#Mini Feaster - Starfall Inversion|Starfall Inversion]

intro: The Mini Feaster is an S-grade Combat Deviation that will mark enemies, or summon tentacles to attack them.

title: Mini Wonder

fields.quote: A cold, black hole of a heart. Black is the color of entropy. When all existences lose their boundaries, all colors blend into one. After an immeasurable amount of light and heat, what remains darkness. "All matter that has form shall die." So live well while we still have the right to live well.
fields.variants: [File:Mini Wonder - Starfall Inversion.png|64px|link=Mini Wonder#Mini Wonder - Starfall Inversion|Starfall Inversion]

intro: Mini Wonder is an S-grade Combat Deviation that can participate in combat to absorb flying bullets toward its owner.

title: Mr. Wish

fields.variants: [File:Mr. Wish - Penguin Hope.png|64px|link=Mr. Wish#Mr. Wish - Penguin Hope|Penguin Hope]
fields.quote: A cuddly alpaca, known at all as "the wise and wonderful Mr. Wish." Mr. Wish claims he can grant anyone's wish, as long as they meet the following 3 conditions:; 1. The wish must be fun, and Mr. Wish gets the final say on what is "fun."; 2. You can't repeat someone else's wish.; 3. Mr. Wish will fulfill your wish in whatever manner he pleases.; And don't take too long about it! Mr. Wish won't wait around forever.

intro: Mr. Wish is an S-grade Combat Deviation.

title: Nutcracker

fields.quote: A brave soldier stands firm at his post. Following every order, never forgetting his mission. Never show the enemy mercy.
fields.variants: Yes

intro: Nutcracker is an A-grade Territory Deviation that works within the Territory to defend it from invading enemies. There are 5 normal, 3 advanced and 1 rare Nutcracker.

title: Orb Lightning

fields.quote: A lively cloud of lightning, flashing and sparking with wisdom. The point of existence is more than to merely exist.

intro: Orb Lightning is a B-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Tactical Items. When thrown, the performance of turrets in the area will be increased.

title: Paper Doll

fields.quote: A normal Paper Doll, small in size yet full of vitality. The courtyard changed into a strange environment after an incidental nap. He must be cautious, and become more sturdy and tough in order not to be knocked down in this cruel new world. Until he meets a new friend that can be relied on and is worthy of his trust. Together, they will keep surviving so that they can return to the world of their memories, and be reunited with the people who matter to them.
fields.variants: [File:Paper Doll - Infrasonic Illusion.png|64px|Infrasonic Illusion] [File:Paper Doll - Witch's Beloved.png|64px|Witch's Beloved]

intro: Paper Doll is a B-grade Territory Deviation that collects materials for use in a Disassembly Bench, improves loot from defeated Deviants, and will repair damaged walls and floors.

title: Party Monkey (Deviation)

fields.quote: A revolting instrument that always has malicious intent. It is unable to read the mood around it and cannot hide its intentions, so it ends up being an irritant. Who could derive fun from it?
fields.name: Party Monkey

intro: Party Monkey (Deviation) is a B-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials and can repair its own replicas. It will attract the threat of nearby monsters.

title: Polar Jelly

fields.quote: A happy little jelly, bobbing along without a care in the world. A powerful life force, it can regenerate most physical damage. No scars, no pain, she laughs in the face of death. But wounds are memories, pain is wisdom, and life is a journey that must end in death. A life without these things... what can it mean?
fields.variants: [File:Polar Jelly - Radiant Variant.png|64px|link=Polar Jelly#Polar Jelly - Radiant Variant|Radiant Variant] [File:Polar Jelly - Starfall Inversion.png|64px|link=Polar Jelly#Polar Jelly - Starfall Inversion|Starfall Inversion]

intro: Note 1: Players can swap worlds/realms (servers) multiple times at the nearest Worldstone and re-check locations for even more spawns!

title: Pup Buddy

fields.quote: A tiny toy balloon dog happily floats in the air. Dogs are born to be companions for children. The dog can fly and can make friends fly too. The dog loves being a balloon, loves friends, and loves humans. Come play with the little dog.
fields.photo-caption: An example of the deviants which award [Pup Buddy].
fields.variants: [File:Pup Buddy - Gold Lightning.png|64px|Pup Buddy - Gold Lightning]

intro: Pup Buddy is an A-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Whim Potions. Use it to increase Load capabilities.

title: Pyro Dino
intro: Note 1: Players can swap worlds/realms (servers) multiple times at the nearest Worldstone and re-check locations for even more spawns!

title: Rain Man

fields.quote: A solitary cloud with a deep lake for a heart. There is no end to the game of hide-and-seek--no one remembers to seek him anymore. The sky is overcast, memories dim. Today is another day of talking to the weeds.
fields.variants: [File:Rain Man - Aberrant Progeny.png|64px|link=Rain Man#Rain Man - Aberrant Progeny|Aberrant Progeny]

intro: Rain Man is an A-grade Territory Deviation that works inside the Territory. Can cause a rainfall around him to help crops grow.

title: Rebecca

fields.variants: [File:Aberrant Progeny - Rebecca.png|64px|link=Rebecca#Aberrant Progeny - Rebecca|Aberrant Progeny]

intro: Rebecca is an S-grade Territory Deviation that can summon the avatar of "herself" to comfort and soothe other Deviations.

title: Shattered Maiden

fields.quote: A shy young girl who has her blushing face covered. Will anyone notice her expression? Will anyone notice her thoughts? She wants to try and make new friends today too.
fields.variants: [File:Shattered Maiden - Wandering Witch.png|64px|link=Shattered Maiden#Shattered Maiden - Wandering Witch|Wandering Witch]

intro: Shattered Maiden is a Combat Deviation that can participate in combat, fearing and freezing enemies. Inflicts Slowdown, Chained, and increases Explosion DMG.

title: Snapshot

fields.quote: An old camera, its shutter pressed time and time again. It craves to capture landscapes, to leave behind evidence. Its been here, and it will leave proof. It refuses to become a fading memory.
fields.variants: [File:Crimson Insight - ZapCam.png|64px|link=ZapCam#Crimson Insight - ZapCam|Crimson Insight]

intro: ZapCam is an A-grade Combat Deviation that can participate in combat to constantly photograph nearby enemies, increasing the Weapon DMG they receive.

title: Snow Globe

fields.quote: A bottled landscape where pure snowflakes float forever. Even the most beautiful scenery loses its enchantment when it remains unchanged for eternity. Art should not stop in its tracks there.
fields.variants: [File:Snow Globe - Aberrant Progeny.png|64px|link=Snow Globe#Snow Globe - Aberrant Progeny|Aberrant Progeny]

intro: Snow Globe is a B-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials that can be used to craft Tactical Items. When thrown, targets will become Frozen.

title: Snowsprite

fields.variants: [File:Chaos Snowsprite.png|64px|link=Snowsprite#Chaos Snowsprite|Chaos]

intro: Snowsprite is an S-grade Combat Deviation that [ADD DESCRIPTION HERE.

title: Soul Summoner
intro: Soul Summoner is an A-grade Combat Deviation that was added on October 29, 2025 with the Version 2.2.0. Update.<ref>https://www.oncehuman.game/news/official/20251022/40779_1266368.html</ref>

title: Space Turner

fields.quote: This little metallic cube is a mirror of the universe. Give it a twist and see what you find. With each combination, the world shifts, just a little.

intro: Unlocks the Space Twister formula. Generates Spatial Keystone material, a required material for crafting the Space Twister tactical item.

title: Strange Door

fields.quote: An unguarded door that links a path which has been split in two. The key has opened the lock, but places are limited. Only two thresholds stand between traveler and destination. But don't look, much less think, of what lies between the thresholds.

intro: Strange Door is an A-grade Crafting Deviation that produces special materials and can repair its own replicas. Its owner can teleport between different Strange Doors.

title: Tar Pudding

fields.quote: A playful little octopus, savoring the richness of the earth. Life always finds unexpected ways forward.
fields.name: Tar Pudding

intro: Tar Pudding is an A-grade Territory Deviation that works within the territory, able to extract crude oil or work in Refining Facilities.

title: The Digby Boy

fields.quote: These tiny metal automata seem friendly enough, but there's not much going on behind those eyes. Survive, build, replicate, build, replicate, build, replicate... If left to their own devices, would they destroy the whole world just so they could build more of their weird little gizmos?
fields.variants: [File:The Digby Boy - Emerald.png|64px|Emerald][File:The Digby Boy - Fortune Dice.png|64px|Fortune Dice][File:The Digby Boy - Prism.png|64px|Prism][File:The Digby Boy - Pure Gold.png|64px|Pure Gold]

intro: The Digby Boy is a B-grade Territory Deviation that works in the territory to gather ores or works at the mining platform.

title: Upper World Spawn

fields.variants: [File:Aberrant Progeny - Upper World Spawn.png|64px|link=Upper World Spawn#Aberrant Progeny - Upper World Spawn|Aberrant Progeny]

intro: Upper World Spawn is an S-grade Crafting Deviation that unlocks the Upper World Protection formula and produces Upper World Feather material, a required material for crafting Upper World Protection tactical items.

title: Voodoo Doll

fields.quote: An ancient figure that some respect from a distance, and some rush madly to meet. Same form, same cause, the same cause and the same effect--this is half of the secret of witchcraft.
fields.variants: [File:Voodoo Doll - Starfall Inversion.png|64px|link=Voodoo Doll#Voodoo Doll - Starfall Inversion|Starfall Inversion]

intro: Voodoo Doll is an A-grade Combat Deviation that can participate in combat, sharing the damage received by its master or possessing enemies so they share the damage its master receives instead.

title: Whalepup

fields.quote: A powerful wish box that transforms whatever you place inside according to your desires. Wishing is an art. Use it wisely for unimaginable outcomes.
fields.name: Whalepup

intro: Whalepup is an A-grade Combat Deviation that was added on October 29, 2025 with the Version 2.2.0. Update.<ref>https://www.oncehuman.game/news/official/20251022/40779_1266368.html</ref>

title: Wish Box

fields.quote: A powerful wish box that transforms whatever you place inside according to your desires. Wishing is an art. Use it wisely for unimaginable outcomes.
fields.name: Wish Box

intro: Wish Box is an A-grade Territory Deviation used in the Territory to transform items into something else after digestion.

title: Zapamander

fields.quote: Zapamander can call forth lightning from the clouds. If the lightning strikes your heart, you'll acquire extreme speed. The storm has been bound, yet its heart remains tethered to the sky.
fields.variants: [File:Zapamander - Gravity Abyss.png|64px|link=Zapamander#Zapamander - Gravity Abyss|Gravity Abyss] [File:Zapamander - Pink Block.png|64px|link=Zapamander#Zapamander - Pink Block|Pink Block]

intro: Zapamander is an S-grade Combat Deviation that was added on October 29, 2025 with the Version 2.2.0. Update.<ref>https://www.oncehuman.game/news/official/20251022/40779_1266368.html</ref> It can participate in combat by summoning thunderclouds to strike enemies and enhancing electrical damage.

title: Zeno-Purifier

fields.variants: None

intro: Zeno-Purifier is an S-grade Combat Deviation that can participate in combat, granting its owner a blink strike ability and attacks enemies with a dark blade.
